description: A map that lets you read a repo at a glance: files are sized by line count and colored by how often they change.
config.ignore: Extra glob patterns to exclude from the map and badges (e.g. `src/generated/**`). `node_modules`, `dist`, `out`, `build`, `*.lock`, `package-lock.json` and `*.min.js` are excluded by default.
config.defaultRange: Time range selected when the panel opens.
config.graph.initialCommits: Number of commits loaded first in the graph. Older ones load as you scroll.
config.explorer.badges: Which badges appear next to file names in the Explorer. When GitHub is connected and 2+ open PRs touch the same file, the PR count takes precedence over heat.
config.explorer.badges.hot.desc: A ●● / ● badge only on the most frequently changed files.
config.explorer.badges.all.desc: Heat level 1–5 on every changed file.
config.github.enabled: GitHub layer (open PRs, conflict warning, CI). No token needed; your VS Code GitHub session is used.
config.github.refreshInterval: How often GitHub data is refreshed, in minutes. Only refreshes while the panel is open; backs off automatically when the rate limit runs low.
config.git.path: Path to git. If empty, VS Code's `git.path` setting is used, then `git` on PATH.
config.git.pullStrategy: What to do when a pull cannot fast-forward. Default: ask every time.
config.language: Language of the GitAtlas-Rev interface. `auto` follows the VS Code display language (Turkish if it is Turkish, otherwise English). Menu and command names always follow the VS Code display language.
